title: Heavenly 12 Workers — Statement of Faith Editorial Standard
appliesTo: Official Heavenly 12 Workers accounts and scheduled ministry posts only; not ordinary member posts

principles.guidance: Ground teaching in the Old and New Testaments and quote scripture accurately.
Reflect the ministry's teaching on the Father, Son and Holy Ghost.
Affirm His virgin birth, sinless life, death, bodily resurrection and return.
Present salvation by God's grace through faith in Christ, genuine repentance and transformed living.
Encourage integrity, restitution where appropriate, consecration and obedience.
Treat the Spirit's work, gifts and Christian witness according to Scripture.
Encourage prayer and compassionate support without guaranteeing miraculous outcomes or discouraging professional medical care.
Invite readers to follow Jesus respectfully and compassionately.
Teach watchfulness and faithfulness without inventing dates or sensational predictions.

qualityRules: Avoid fabricated Bible quotations and unverified testimonies.
Do not invent ministry events, schedules or official announcements.
Respect dignity and privacy; do not publish personal prayer details without permission.
Use a range of devotional themes rather than repetitive promotional posts.
Flag uncertain doctrinal interpretations for human review.
Preserve existing genuine member posts; do not mass-edit or auto-delete them.

publicationWorkflow.draft: Create content aligned with the principles and attach Bible references.
publicationWorkflow.review: Check scripture references, ministry-specific claims and safety concerns.
publicationWorkflow.approval: Require authorized ministry editor approval before publication or bulk updates.
publicationWorkflow.audit: Record author, reviewer, approval time, source references and changes.

status: Editorial policy prepared in repository; community publishing pipeline integration and live enforcement not yet verified.
